ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda pre-encryption Safe Mode boot pivot with recovery wipe
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook Qilin (Trend Micro 'Agenda' / 'Water Galura') runbook of using bcdedit to flip the host into Safe Mode (minimal or network) so its Rust/Go encryptor can run under a stripped boot environment with EDR drivers offline, immediately followed by vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit recovery destruction on the same host. The pairing within a tight window is highly specific to ransomware actors that boot-to-encrypt — Qilin, Snatch, and BlackByte — and is not a normal IT operation.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.user) as users values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND Processes.process="*safeboot*" AND (Processes.process="*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*network*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*Win32_ShadowCopy*")) ) by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process | eval IsSafeMode=if(match(process,"(?i)safeboot.{1,15}(minimal|network)"),1,0), IsRecovery=if(match(process,"(?i)(delete shadows|delete catalog|recoveryenabled no|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures|shadowcopy delete|Win32_ShadowCopy)"),1,0) | stats sum(IsSafeMode) as safe_mode_actions sum(IsRecovery) as recovery_actions values(process) as commands values(users) as users values(parents) as parents earliest(firstTime) as firstTime latest(lastTime) as lastTime by dest | where safe_mode_actions>=1 AND recovery_actions>=1 AND (lastTime - firstTime) <= 1800 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let SafeModePrep = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("minimal", "network")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeModeTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SafeModeCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SafeModeAccount = AccountName,
              SafeModeParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let RecoveryInhibit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        "delete shadows", "delete catalog",
        "recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
        "shadowcopy delete", "Win32_ShadowCopy")
    | project RecoveryTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
SafeModePrep
| join kind=inner RecoveryInhibit on DeviceId
| where RecoveryTime between (SafeModeTime - WindowMinutes .. SafeModeTime + WindowMinutes)
| project SafeModeTime, RecoveryTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', RecoveryTime, SafeModeTime),
          DeviceName, SafeModeAccount, SafeModeParent,
          SafeModeCmd, RecoveryCmd
| order by SafeModeTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let SafeModePrep = SecurityEvent

    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("minimal", "network")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeModeTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              SafeModeCmd = CommandLine,
              SafeModeAccount = SubjectUserName,
              SafeModeParent = ParentProcessName;
let RecoveryInhibit = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe"
        or NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe"
        or NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe"
        or NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
        or NewProcessName endswith @"\powershell.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any (
        "delete shadows", "delete catalog",
        "recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
        "shadowcopy delete", "Win32_ShadowCopy")
    | project RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              RecoveryCmd = CommandLine;
SafeModePrep
| join kind=inner RecoveryInhibit on Computer
| where RecoveryTime between (SafeModeTime - WindowMin .. SafeModeTime + WindowMin)
| project SafeModeTime, RecoveryTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', RecoveryTime, SafeModeTime),
          Computer, SafeModeAccount, SafeModeParent,
          SafeModeCmd, RecoveryCmd
| order by SafeModeTime desc

status: experimental
description: Detects use of bcdedit to enable Safe Mode boot. Qilin/Agenda ransomware reboots victims into Safe Mode (minimal or network) to bypass EDR before deploying its Rust/Go encryptor — a TTP shared with Snatch and BlackByte but rare outside ransomware impact stages.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/k/agenda-ransomware-uses-rust-to-target-more-vital-industries.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/03

logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:

    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_safeboot:
    CommandLine|contains: 'safeboot'
  selection_mode:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'minimal'
      - 'network'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Rare legitimate disaster-recovery test or driver troubleshooting performed by IT operations

| ( (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i regex("(?i)safeboot.{1,15}(minimal|network)", field=CommandLine)) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wbadmin|wmic|bcdedit|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i regex("(?i)(delete\\s+shadows|delete\\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|shadowcopy\\s+delete|Win32_ShadowCopy)", field=CommandLine)) )

| WindowSec <= 1800

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda encryptor service-kill volley (Veeam/MSSQL/Sophos/Sense backup-and-EDR teardown)
ucs.description: Hunts the hardcoded service-kill loop embedded in Qilin's Rust and Go encryptors, which iterates a fixed list of backup, database and EDR service names (veeam, mssql, mepocs, memtas, sophos, sense, vss, vsnap, msexchange, acronis, etc.) and calls taskkill/sc stop/net stop or PowerShell Stop-Service against each one in a tight window before kicking off encryption. The detection fires when ≥3 distinct targets from that list are hit by an interactive (non-machine) account within 5 minutes — the encryptor's pre-impact preparation pattern.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*stop*" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Service*" OR Processes.process="*/f*" OR Processes.process="*kill*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name _time span=1m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval lc=lower(process) | rex field=lc max_match=20 "(?<token>veeam|mssql|mepocs|memtas|sophos|sense|vss|vsnap|msexchange|mysql|postgres|kavfs|wsbex|sqlbrowser|sqlwriter|sqlsafe|tomcat|acronis|ccsvchst|savservice|truebackup|oracle|backup|exchange|defender|sqlserver)" | where isnotnull(token) | stats dc(token) as distinct_targets values(token) as targets values(process) as commands values(process_name) as binaries values(parent_process_name) as parents earliest(_time) as firstTime latest(_time) as lastTime by dest user | where distinct_targets >= 3 AND NOT match(user,"\$$") AND (lastTime - firstTime) <= 300 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 5m;
let TargetTokens = dynamic([
    "veeam","mssql","mepocs","memtas","sophos","sense","vss",
    "vsnap","msexchange","mysql","postgres","kavfs","wsbex",
    "sqlbrowser","sqlwriter","sqlsafe","tomcat","acronis",
    "ccsvchst","savservice","truebackup","oracle","backup",
    "exchange","defender","sqlserver"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","/f","kill","Stop-Service")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend lcCmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| mv-expand Token = TargetTokens to typeof(string)
| where lcCmd contains Token
| summarize
    DistinctTargets = dcount(Token),
    TargetsHit = make_set(Token, 25),
    Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
    Binaries = make_set(FileName, 10),
    Initiators = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
    First = min(Timestamp),
    Last = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where DistinctTargets >= 3
| extend SpanSec = datetime_diff('second', Last, First)
| project First, Last, SpanSec, DeviceName, AccountName, DistinctTargets, TargetsHit, Binaries, Initiators, Commands
| order by Last desc
